LESSON: BASKETBALL AND LOGO DESIGN

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.9: Basketball and Logo Design

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Basketball and Logo Design. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can a poster be made an effective means of communicating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition
2. appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BASKETBALL AND LOGO DESIGN
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Basketball and Logo Design helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BASKETBALL AND LOGO DESIGN
Study Basketball and Logo Design like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition

What this means
In this part you learn to perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Basketball and Logo Design” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Basketball and Logo Design in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Basketball and Logo Design is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Basketball and Logo Design” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Basketball and Logo Design in your own words. (skill: appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Basketball and Logo Design to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Basketball and Logo Design from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Basketball and Logo Design: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Basketball and Logo Design?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can a poster be made an effective means of communicating?
2. Why is it important to combine passing and dribbling in Basketball?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Basketball and Logo Design means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: perform passes in Basketball for skill acquisition.
5. Be able to: appreciate each other’s skills in Basketball game.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
